mechanism_narrative: The persistent decline in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES reflects ongoing stay-at-home orders that remove commuter and workplace footfall, directly depressing retail-and-recreation visits. As long as these series remain in steep negative territory, RETAIL_REC will stay lower over the next four weeks than in the prior four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days exceeds the mean over the last 28 days while TRANSIT and WORKPLACES continue to decline or remain below -40.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL mobility exceeds +20 percent, it signals maximum home confinement and triggers policy review for staged reopening; this policy shift lifts retail-and-recreation mobility over the following four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days despite RESIDENTIAL exceeding +20 percent at the decision point.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp fall in TRANSIT below -40 combined with GROCERY_PHARM remaining positive indicates that only essential trips are occurring; this substitution effect starves retail-and-recreation of footfall, pushing RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -40 and GROCERY_PHARM stays above 0
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 14 days when TRANSIT is below -40 and GROCERY_PHARM is above 0 at the decision point.

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening-restrictions regime, a week-on-week rise in PARKS mobility reflects outdoor exercise substitution rather than retail demand, so it does not lift RETAIL_REC and instead confirms that discretionary retail remains suppressed.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises more than 10 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is higher than over the prior 14 days when PARKS rises more than 10 points week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM turning negative signals that even essential shopping trips are being consolidated or avoided, reducing overall trip frequency and pulling RETAIL_REC further down over the next week.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is higher than over the prior 7 days when GROCERY_PHARM is below 0.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction of WORKPLACES falling below -35 and RESIDENTIAL rising above +15 identifies a full lockdown state where home becomes the exclusive hub; this combination removes weekday retail traffic and drives RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls below -35 and RESIDENTIAL rises above +15
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days when WORKPLACES is below -35 and RESIDENTIAL is above +15.

mechanism_narrative: Autumn seasonal norms would normally lower PARKS mobility, but the current swing from +27.3 to -15.6 shows disrupted outdoor routines that also suppress retail spillover; RETAIL_REC remains lower over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days despite PARKS two-week change exceeding 30 points.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT's week-on-week decline stabilizes above -5 points, it signals the start of a reopening regime; retail-and-recreation mobility then recovers as restrictions ease, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT week-on-week change is greater than -5 points
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is lower than over the prior 14 days when TRANSIT week-on-week change is greater than -5 points.
